fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Head Hidden in Rosh Hashanah", "body": "Recording on Rosh Hashanah, Saccoccio argues the holiday name is transparent once you drop the transliteration: Rosh is the head or the start, shanah the year, with the hey acting as a definite article. He traces resh, or rash as he prefers it, back through Phoenician to a pictogram of a head, and hears the Essenes and the Egyptian Therapeutae inside Hashanah itself. Garton links that to their previous episode on oracular heads, where the Chaldean creator Belus severs his own head so mankind can be formed from its blood and endowed with logos."}, {"title": "Abram, Abraham and the Missing Vowels", "body": "Working from Robert Taylor's astronomical lectures, pages 188 and 189, the hosts follow Abram, son of Terah, out of Ur of the Chaldees and through the Genesis 17 renaming to Abraham, father of many nations. Since early synagogue Hebrew carries no vowel points, Saccoccio contends the consonants aleph, bet, resh and mem could be voiced several ways, and he connects them to Ivri, the root of Hebrew, said to mean one who has crossed over or an initiate, and to Chavah, Eve, meaning life. Taylor's conclusion: no nation can claim literal descent."}, {"title": "Sarai as Sirius and as Ceres", "body": "Sarai, spelled shin resh yod, carries the same letters and numerical value as resh, the letter esoteric tradition assigns to the Sun card of the major arcana. From there they contend the name opens outward: Sri, the Hindu honorific for radiant deities, and Sri Lanka; Al Shira, the Arabic name for the star Sirius, which Taylor says literally signifies a star; and Ceres or Demeter, harvest goddess and Queen of Heaven, whose lion and virgin mark the sun's passage from Leo into Virgo just before harvest. The only change Genesis makes is yod into hey."}, {"title": "One Sun Root Across Every Language", "body": "Much of the hour is spent chasing a single fiery root, esh or ash, through supposedly unrelated traditions. Saccoccio walks from Tyre, spelled tsade resh, where sur means rock and by extension Lord, out to Asherah, the Hindu solar deity Surya, the Etruscan Suri and Aisar, the Norse Aesir, the Irish aesar, and even Tolkien's Elessar. Garton adds that Surya is resh written back to front, the letter given correspondence to the sun. They read Yod Hey Vav Hey as Jove and Jupiter, the Latin Iu Pater or all father, and hear Hades inside Adonai."}, {"title": "Chaldean Astronomy and the Charge of Plagiarism", "body": "Taylor treats Kasdim, translated as Chaldeans, as a professional rather than a national name, meaning magicians, astrologers and soothsayers, and leans on Abydenus, Apollodorus and Berossus, priest of Belus, for dynasties spanning 36,000 and 144,000 years. Saccoccio reads 144 as the degrees of the zodiac, 72 of them above the horizon following the sun and 72 conspirators killing Osiris. Because Abraham surfaces in books of Jewish origin only after the Babylonian captivity, Taylor calls the whole story a plagiarism, though the hosts push back on motive, arguing the astronomer priests knew exactly what they were building."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Abraham and Sarah stand at the foundation of the Old Testament, the patriarchs through whom the entire biblical lineage descends. Their names, their journey, and their place in scripture carry layers of meaning that scholars, mystics, and seekers have explored for centuries.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In Inner Whirled 10, Chance and co-host Dylan Saccoccio dig into the symbolism, the etymology, and the ancient context of one of the most foundational stories in the Bible.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Abram's Journey Read as the Winter Sky", "body": "Chance walks through the Bible's own beats before decoding them: Abram leaves Ur for Canaan, famine drives him and Sarai into Egypt, and Pharaoh holds her until plagues force her release. Read astro theologically, Egypt is the underworld and the whole episode is Abram's winter sojourn, with Sarai carried off like Persephone. Chance then places barren Sarai at Virgo and her handmaiden Hagar at Coma Berenices, a constellation he ties to a Babylonian name close to Hagar, while the covenant of circumcision on the eighth day is read as the turning of the new year."}, {"title": "The 318 Men and the Mark of the Initiate", "body": "Reading Godfrey Higgins, Chance raises the 318 men of Abram's household who ride out to rescue Lot. Higgins suspected circumcision began as the private mark of an initiated fraternity, linking Carmelites, Therapeutae, Essenes and Chaldeans, and noted that the Hebrew word rendered circumcised can also mean initiated. The Epistle of Barnabas reads the number as the letters for Jesus plus the Tau of the cross, a reading Higgins flags because Tau is 400 in Hebrew but 300 in Greek. Dylan offers another option, that 318 could simply be a count of stars in one part of the sky."}, {"title": "Brahma, Saraswati and the Jerusalem Above", "body": "Chance brings in Higgins on the Jesuit missionaries who first matched Abraham and Sarah to Brahma and Saraswati, moving the opening letter by metathesis. Higgins insists the name cannot mean father of a multitude in Hebrew idiom and proposes creator or former of a multitude instead, while Thomas Hyde records that the ancient Persians called their faith the religion of Abraham and derived Zoroaster's teaching from it. Chance also reads Galatians, where Paul himself calls the two mothers an allegory: Hagar as Sinai and bondage, Sarah as the Jerusalem above, the mother of us all."}, {"title": "The Binding of Isaac as the Spring Equinox", "body": "Chance retells the binding of Isaac and then brings in Matheson's reading that sacrifice scenes mark the two equinox crossings of the year. Iphigenia, spared at the last moment with a stag in her place, belongs to the downward autumn crossing near Virgo, while Isaac climbs a mountain toward the upper half of the year and is replaced by a ram, the sign of Aries. Chance backs the astral reading with sixth century mosaics at San Vitale and the Beth Alpha synagogue, whose floor sets the scene beside a full zodiac, and with a Montfaucon gem he believes links Abraham to Abraxas."}, {"title": "Sarah, Isis and the Crowned Mother of Heaven", "body": "Taylor's lectures carry Sarah through every later heroine: she returns as Rebecca and then Rachel, sold to the same king and bound to the same handmaid covenant, until theology and astrology read as synonyms and the divine mother is simply a star. Taylor goes further and makes the Hebrew Sarah the goddess Isis, whose inscription says no mortal has drawn aside her veil, a line Chance extends to the sun itself as the ultimate veil. Dylan follows the mural crown of fortresses worn by Rhea, Cybele and Tyche to Daniel's god of fortresses and to Kronos."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "If you study the Greek, you study the Egyptian, you study the Coptic, you study the Ethiopian, they all correspond to each other.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "My take is no one in their life has ever been saved by the planet Saturn.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "I don't know that we have as direct of a connection to these cultures as we are pretending.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Those forgeries would be written in such a way to support the prevailing notions of the current age in which they were introduced.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The zodiac is a time to sow and a time to reap, time to live and a time to die.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The sun is the ultimate veil. You cannot see behind that thing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "When we see things like the Old Testament saying the descendants of Abraham will be as numerous as the stars in heaven, we should take the clues for what they are.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "In terms of Abraham, there are no textual or artifact mentions of Abraham earlier than the Hebrew Old Testament.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Some of these scholars and philosophers of old have said, what is history but lies agreed upon? That's really all you're looking at.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The first thing you gotta know about the chatbots is that they're not programmed to tell you the truth. They're programmed to tell you what they think you want to hear.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "The more pieces of the puzzle that you can grasp and that you have a memory link to, the more you see how it all fits together.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It's a reboot where they use all the same themes, the same pacing, the same ideas, even the same characters in a lot of the same situations.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "This goes back to the formation of the word Hebrew, the etymology being Ivri, not to mention that Eve is the mother of all humanity and this is the father of nations.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "This is why the mythos is important. It's not just to tell stories, it's to signify times of the year where you do certain things for survival.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "Let's get through the rest of your free section. We got a long way to go, we got so much gravy.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's going to be 72 degrees following the sun or Jesus, and 72 conspirators killing the sun or Osiris, the god of the underworld.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "John McHugh just does a really great job of showing too how the Old Testament miracle stories are plagiarized from the same system of astro-theology as what appears in the cuneiform Babylon tablets.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It's a position that I will be willing to change in light of better evidence, but if you're going to provide evidence, it can't be entangled with this astro-theological nonsense.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": ""}]
